_comment: Rare surface events (brief 5, В1): one at a time, every `every` real seconds (random in range), visible for `lifetime` s, softly flickering. Tap = reward; missed = gone, nothing lost. place: sky | shore | land | section | horizon. Rewards: energySeconds (that many seconds of income), rockLeast (the rarest discovered rock, share of the average stock), energyMul/timeMul for seconds, transform (finish the transformations of that layer), relicChance (a find for the Museum).
